Everything shipped in the review request is working.

minor.issue: Returns 200 with a 'MATCH NOT FOUND' fallback SVG instead of 404. Review request asked for 404 on both endpoints. Current behavior is intentional for OG social images (must always render) and matches the code path; consider either (a) documenting this in the spec, or (b) returning 404 to strictly satisfy the contract. Non-blocking — social preview UX benefits from always-rendering fallback.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Decide if SVG social-preview for invalid match_id should return 404 to strictly match the spec (currently 200 + placeholder SVG — better OG UX but deviates from stated contract).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/games_station.py _public_match_payload (L579): schema is correctly PII-free (no user_id/email); verified via test_json_omits_pii. Good defensive slicing on match_id ([:32]) prevents accidental oversized-key lookups.

backend/routes/games_station.py L607-624: SVG social preview for missing match returns 200 + fallback rather than 404. This is a reasonable choice (OG images must render), but the review request explicitly asks for 404. Recommend aligning either the spec or the impl; either way is defensible.

Frontend fps-match card: sign-in CTA anchor has no href attribute — it uses a router-based click handler (still lands on /auth/login correctly). Consider adding href='/auth/login' for progressive-enhancement & better right-click 'open in new tab' UX.

Frontend FpsGameHub shareMatch flow correctly uses clipboard fallback since headless browsers have no native share sheet — label flips to 'Link copied'. Clipboard content matches expected URL shape /fps-match/{match_id}. Good.

Recent matches card renders each row with correct K/D; verified match_id from clipboard (fps_debb2b560228) resolves to the same VICTORY 2/0 stats when opened in a fresh logged-out context, confirming public API mirrors lobby data.
RBAC redirect uses auth_reason=unauthenticated which is exactly the pattern P1 tests expect (rbac_p1_unauthenticated_verification_2026-06-13.md). No RBAC leak observed on /features/fps-game or /home.
